scope: exploratory grouped CV on previously studied training source
features: mean of all raw BPE lookback features in window, including punctuation
label: any original eligible token inside window is risk
unknown_or_refusal: exclude from primary windows; report coverage
pool_baseline: maximum frozen Round13 C=.01 token score over original eligible lexical tokens inside same window
weighting: group/condition/item balanced, class factors fit-only, then total loss weight scaled to fit K1 token count
threshold: per window size and method, calibration groups only; F1 then precision then higher threshold
primary_comparisons: window-trained minus token-max on same width, not across widths
